hero.subtitle: Mtundu watsopano wogawana mafayilo wa peer-to-peer
hero.description: Womangidwa pa luso lamakono lopanda mfundo yapakati. Palibe ma seva apakati. Palibe malo amodzi olephera.

about.title: Zokhudza
about.intro: {project} ndi nsanja yogawana mafayilo ya peer-to-peer ya mtundu watsopano yomangidwa pa luso lamakono lopanda mfundo yapakati. Imaphatikiza kapangidwe kosavuta ka wogwiritsa ntchito ndi kapangidwe kopanda mfundo yapakati, kupereka njira yotetezeka komanso yodalirika yogawana zambiri popanda kudalira ulamuliro uliwonse wapakati. Pulojekitiyi ndi open source ndipo imagawidwa pansi pa {license}.

decentralized.title: Maukonde opanda mfundo yapakati kwathunthu
decentralized.description: Palibe ma seva apakati, palibe malo amodzi olephera. Ogwiritsa ntchito amasaka ndi kutsitsa zomwe zili pakati pawo, popanda kudalira zolemba zapakati, otsatira kapena ma database.

accessControl.title: Kuwongolera kolowamo mwatsatanetsatane
accessControl.description: Aliyense ali ndi ufulu woyambitsa maukonde ake ndi malamulo ake. Tanthauzani maudindo a wogwiritsa ntchito mu maukonde aliwonse: eni, oyang'anira, osindikiza, owongolera ndi otsitsa. Wongolerani ndendende amene angasindikize, awongolere ndi kutsitsa zomwe zili.

ui.title: Kapangidwe kabwino kwambiri ka wogwiritsa ntchito
ui.description: Kapangidwe ka media center koyera komanso kosavuta kogwiritsa ntchito kopangidwa kwa ma desktop, TV ndi mafoni. Yendani mosavuta ndi kibodi, mbewa, gamepad kapena chowongolera chakutali. Ogwiritsa ntchito odziwa angagwiritse ntchito kapangidwe ka mzere wa malamulo kuti agwiritse ntchito pulogalamuyi ngati seva yamafayilo yopanda mutu.

dataFormat.title: Mawonekedwe a deta omwe munthu angawerenge
dataFormat.description: Mawonekedwe a deta a LISH amatengera pa JSON, kupangitsa kuti zikhale zosavuta kupanga, kuwerenga ndi kumvetsa. Gawanani zomwe zili ndi metadata yomveka bwino, yomveka yomwe aliyense angawunike mosavuta.

security.title: Chinsinsi ndi chitetezo
security.description: Kulumikizana konse kwa peer-to-peer ndi kosindikizidwa, kuwonetsetsa kuti deta yanu imakhalabe yachinsinsi panthawi yotumiza. Ogwiritsa ntchito akhoza kubisala kumbuyo kwa VPN kuti apeze chigawo china chosadziwika. {project} imalemekeza chinsinsi chanu mwa kapangidwe.

crossPlatform.title: Cross-platform
crossPlatform.description: Pulogalamuyi imapezeka pa Windows, Linux ndi macOS. Igwiritseni ntchito pa chida chilichonse chomwe mukufuna.

download.title: Tsitsa
download.description: Pezani {project} pa nsanja yanu. Kutsitsa konse ndi kwaulere komanso kwa open source.

macos.title: Chidziwitso chofunika kwa ogwiritsa ntchito macOS:
macos.intro: macOS Gatekeeper imatsekereza ma app osasayinidwa / osatsimikizika otsitsidwa pa intaneti ndi cholakwika cha {error}.
macos.runCommand: Mukatsitsa DMG kapena ZIP, yendetsani lamulo mu Terminal mwanjira yotsatirayi musanatsegule app:
macos.explanation: Izi zimachotsa chizindikiro cha karenteni ndi kulola app kuyenda.
